review_scope: Independent fresh-context review of current complete D7 only; no earlier proof versions or reviews consulted.

comprehension.claim: Conditional preservation of publication validity under complete commit, whole-object preservation, or synchronized quarantine; conditional R+T useful recovery from two separately proved bounded obligations.
comprehension.induction: From a valid start, complete commit preserves validity, preservation leaves the old boundary intact, and quarantine prevents affected authorization. From a quarantined start, preservation keeps authorization disabled; only a verified complete valid initialization or commit exits quarantine. The induction concerns authorization safety, not validity of stored data while quarantined.
comprehension.consumption_and_publication: Successful evidence consumption followed by query failure retains the committed prefix and unresolved readout. It does not relabel consumed input as retryable fresh evidence. A preserved older object can authorize only for its actual unchanged boundary.
comprehension.read_synchronization: Endpoint induction alone is insufficient. The explicit synchronization assumption covers intermediate readers, identity/certificate coherence, and invalidation during publication, reset, and restore.
comprehension.recovery_and_reset: R is supplied by a verified bounded recovery controller on a qualified class after faults cease; T is supplied by a useful-authorization guarantee under compatible conditions thereafter. Gap replay or qualified propagation, aged-cell initial support, and lifetime-risk reset accounting are explicit separate prerequisites.
comprehension.counterexample_search: Considered repeated failure from invalid quarantined storage, query failure after committed consumption, reader interleaving with partial mutation, stale publications after restore or faults, repeated rollback/replay, and permanent sensor or power failure. Each is excluded by an explicit premise or scoped limitation; no counterexample to the stated conditional claims was found.

remaining_application_obligations: Define and establish the complete admitted update, publication, reset, restore, and fault transition relation, including the initial publication-authority state; the current H7 field-flush backend is explicitly not certified.

Prove atomic complete-object commit or whole-object preservation, once-only observation ownership, ordered physical transitions, and correct consumed/unconsumed status across every admitted failure and retry.
Implement and verify reader/mutator synchronization, immutable identity-bound certificates, expiry and revocation enforcement, quarantine authorization suppression, and verified quarantine exit.
Specify the detectable fault model and separately establish containment; arbitrary undetected corruption is outside this theorem.

Prove a concrete recovery controller reaches a valid state within R on its qualified recoverable class and prove useful query authorization within T under the same continuing power, sensor, and informative-use scenario.
Qualify checkpoint integrity and reset/configuration identity, gap replay or uncertain propagation, aged-cell initial support after SRAM loss, and lifetime-risk accounting across resets.
Qualify any system fallback action for available power and voltage; bounded refusal does not establish useful availability.
